items.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
items.description: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.

items.title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
items.description: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

items.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
items.description: Scientists say the developing El Niño is now the strongest on record with weather impacts already being felt around the world.

items.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
items.description: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to investigate juror and check his phone
items.description: The attorney wants the court to look at the juror's mobile phone use and answers on questionnaires.

items.title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
items.description: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system - was ruled an accident.

items.title: Veteran BBC Africa correspondent Mark Doyle dies aged 67
items.description: Doyle was best known for reporting on African conflicts in the 1990s and 2000s, notably in Rwanda and Sierra Leone.
